The recorder registers both events, but this change has no search or contact caller to publish them. T1B owns publishing searches with the total people found only on page 1; T1C owns publishing successful WhatsApp taps. Their API tests also own proving that recording cannot delay or block either response. Until those tasks land, the Done-when usage counts are not end to end.
